initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-28430 was found. FHIR-I minutes on 2023-03-13 recorded the issue as already applied, and the R5 publication already lists MedicationRequest with title MedicationRequest.medication under Medication's generated reference list.
additional_context: Medication and MedicationRequest are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current MedicationRequest StructureDefinition declares MedicationRequest.medication as CodeableReference with targetProfile Medication. Current CI output also lists MedicationRequest.medication under Medication references. FHIR-29662 records a similar CodeableReference reference-list complaint as already fixed in tooling for CI/R4B.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative source contains the needed CodeableReference targetProfile and the applied R5/current generated outputs already show the reported reference, so an additional FHIR core source edit would be redundant.
